  <section class="approach" aria-labelledby="approach-heading"><div class="section-heading"><div><p class="eyebrow">03 / HOW I THINK</p><h2 id="approach-heading">A question-first approach.</h2></div></div><ol class="process"><li><span class="process-number">01</span><h3>Ask</h3><p>Define the business question and what a useful answer would look like.</p></li><li><span class="process-number">02</span><h3>Explore</h3><p>Check the data, look for patterns, and challenge the first explanation.</p></li><li><span class="process-number">03</span><h3>Explain</h3><p>Make the findings understandable, including what the data cannot tell us.</p></li><li><span class="process-number">04</span><h3>Apply</h3><p>Connect the evidence to a practical recommendation or a better next question.</p></li></ol></section>
